description:
Hi everyone! 

I'm building IGNIS for NASA Space Apps 2026, an AI-powered platform exploring fire-safety insights from NASA's microgravity combustion data.
I bring skills in Python, React, FastAPI, and AI/ML. 
Looking for collaborators interested in RAG, UI/UX, data science, physics, or space research. 

Experienced or beginner, let's connect, combine our strengths, and build something amazing together!
